_comment: Avoided emissions for all companies. For a company with a defined intervention location (a single node, or a connected flow across adjacent levels, e.g. sector->equipment) and a per-scenario avoided_emissions figure, values are distributed across the location's edges in proportion to that scenario's own baseline flow through the location (CurrentPolicies for 2040A, StatedCommitments for 2040B). 2040C has no baseline data yet, so its values are always null. Companies without a location, or without a figure for a given scenario, keep null links for that scenario. Theme totals live under `by_theme` (indexed by `themes`): each theme sums its member companies' links edge-by-edge (summing only members that have a value for a given scenario/edge). A theme whose members declare overlapping intervention locations is blocked (null links, non-null `blocked_reason`) pending an attribution policy; shared downstream edges do not block.
